content: अमोघ {%a.%} .²1 Unfailing, reaching the mark; धनुष्यमोघं समधत्त बाणम् <ls>Ku. 3. 66</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 53</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 97</ls>; कामिलक्ष्येष्वमोघैः <ls>Me. 75</ls>. .²2 Unerring, infallible (words, boon <ab>&c.</ab>); अमोघाः प्रतिगृह्णन्तावर्घ्यानुपदमाशिषः <ls>R. 1. 44</ls>; युतममोघतया <ls>Ki. 6. 40</ls>. .²3 Not vain or useless, efficacious, fruitful, productive; यदमोघमपामन्तरुप्तं बीजमज त्वया <ls>Ku. 2. 5</ls>; so ˚बलम्, ˚शक्ति, ˚वीर्य, ˚क्रोध <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-घः@} .²1 Not failing or erring, unerringness. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu (or of Śiva according to some). .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a river. .{@-घा@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the plant पाटली (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>पाडळी</ns>) (the trumpet flower). .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of another plant विडङ्ग (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>वावडिंग</ns>) the seed of which is used as a vermifuge, and hence also called कृमिघ्न. .²3 = पथ्या. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a spear or शक्ति. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Śivaʼs wife. .²6 Mystical name of the conjunct consonant क्ष.
